title: Make the final distribution
summary: Run the waterfall on the sale proceeds and pay investors and the sponsor.
outlineSteps: Reconcile net sale proceeds to the settlement statement
Settle remaining payables, reserves and loan items
Decide the holdback for wind-down costs and claims
Read the governing agreement's distribution terms
Run the waterfall on the proceeds
Have a second person check the waterfall
Get the approvals the governing agreement requires
Send each investor a statement of the distribution
Give the tax preparer the gain split for investors' reporting
